requests.name: POST Enroll myself (multi-select fields)
requests.testScript:
pw.test("Status is 201", () => { pw.expect(pw.response.status).toBe(201); });
const d = pw.response.body.data; if (d && d.enrollment && d.enrollment.id) pw.env.set('enrollmentId', d.enrollment.id);
requests.description:
Farmer enrolls THEMSELVES with their chosen fields (multiple allowed). No assessorId - an admin assigns the assessor later. Enforces program active + user_limit + no duplicate + field ownership. Needs a FARMER token.

### Expected response (Created 201)

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Enrolled successfully.",
  "data": {
    "enrollment": {
      "id": "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
      "program_id": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
      "farmer_id": "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
      "farmer_name": "John Smith",
      "farmer_email": "john@example.com",
      "assessor_id": null,
      "assessor_name": null,
      "assessor_email": null,
      "enrolled_by": "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
      "status": "active",
      "note": "wheat fields only",
      "enrolled_at": "2026-07-01T12:00:00.000Z",
      "fields": [
        {
          "id": "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
          "field_id": "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
          "field_name": "North Field",
          "farm_name": "Green Valley Farm"
        },
        {
          "id": "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
          "field_id": "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa",
          "field_name": "East Field",
          "farm_name": "Green Valley Farm"
        }
      ],
      "created_at": "2026-07-01T12:00:00.000Z",
      "updated_at": "2026-07-01T12:00:00.000Z"
    }
  }
}
```

**Future-start programs (upcoming):** a program whose start_date is in the FUTURE is NOT open for enrollment yet - this returns 400 ("Enrollment opens on <date>..."). Enrollment opens on the start date. Same rule for admin enroll + self-enroll. Ended programs (end_date past) also 400.

Success example.name: Success example
